output.summary: The slip comes from the single-reviewer security gate. Squad-controlled stages are unchanged, and all the added time sits between QA pass and AppSec sign-off (E5). Queue depth and wait grew while reviewer throughput stayed flat (E4). The August delegate cleared the backlog and releases resumed, with no other changes (E6). Non-gated Reporting patches still ship every 14 days (E12). Engineer output, tech debt and CI health are flat (E7, E11), and idle tickets are mostly 'Awaiting SecReview' (E9). So discipline, tech debt and reviewer slowness are contradicted. Morale is probably a consequence, plus the salary freeze. Add review capacity now. Do not suspend the gate or launch the accountability program. Defer risk-tiering until review outcome data exists (Q1, Q2).
